modules.name: Gongoozler
modules.description: Gong and tam-tam physical model: 256 modes, tam-tam, wind gong, opera gong and bossed (gamelan) gong; a hard hit blooms from a low hum into a shimmering wash, opera gongs bend in pitch, bossed gongs beat slowly; mallet, strike position, towel mute and hand grab

modules.name: Gonzo
modules.description: The Gongoozler gong engine pushed past real gongs: 2 cm to 20 m, mode spacing LAW and ORDER (harmonic to scattered), DENSITY, BOW and audio EXCITE, freeze, reversed tilt, and a bloom that can sink into the lows instead of climbing
